Bleach Wii - Hakujin Kirameku Rondo.name: Bleach: Shattered Blade
Bleach Wii - Hakujin Kirameku Rondo.summary: Fighting game developed by Sega taking place in the Bleach universe. Takes advantage of the wii motion sensor controls and focuses on the story of a game exclusive character called Arturo Plateado.

Bomberman Land.name: Bomberman Land
Bomberman Land.summary:
Bombermand Land is a revamped continuation of the Bomberman series. There is a single-player Story Mode where the player travels through the Bomberman universe in order to bring peace to it once again by solving puzzles, defeating enemies and collecting power-ups and weapons to defeat them. There are 40 different single-player minigames and 5 multiplayer games to choose from, ranging from skiing, skateboarding, laser ball, archery among many others.

There is also the classic Bomberman which can also allow up to four human opponents in six different battle modes to compete in: Normal, Points, Stars, Crown, All-Out and Wii (which uses the Wii Remote to throw bombs, an exclusive mode for the Wii)

NBA 2K13.name: NBA 2K13
NBA 2K13.summary: With more than 5 million copies sold worldwide and more than 25 Sports Game of the Year awards won, NBA 2K12 was another monster release for the biggest NBA video game simulation franchise in the world. This year, 2K Sports has joined forces with the legendary JAY Z as Executive Producer to transcend sports video games and take virtual hardwood to the next level. Featuring an enhanced MyCAREER mode and all-new gameplay features, NBA 2K13 will let gamers pit the best players in NBA history against the new dynasty of talent, including the much-debated matchup between the 2012 U.S. Men's National Team and the 1992 "Dream Team."

Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer.name: Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer
Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer.summary: Join in all the Reindeer Games in this adaptation of the classic claymation holiday story. Race in Blitzen's Blitz, build toys in Santa's Workshop, defang the Bumble, stay on top in the Iceberg Hop, escape the Island of Misfit Toys, and light the way for Santa's Sleigh!

Think - Logic Trainer.name: Th!nk Logic Trainer
Think - Logic Trainer.summary: Think! Logic Trainer is an original brain training game that can help improve many cognitive abilities through play. It helps enhance language, maths, logic skills and spatial reasoning. All activities are presented on fun, imaginative and creative way. Think! Logic Trainer, a fun educational game for the whole family. It encourages you to think outside the box and help you keep your brain fit. There are over 80000 stimulating different exercises to challenge your well toned mind. All exercises presented encourage the coordination of the right and left hemisphere of your brain. Training and stimulation of these area can help improve creativity, logical thinking and develops imagination. Think! Logic Trainer Wii allows you to have your own personal training program where you can keep track of your progress. Throughout the game, you will be given valuable tips to help you master every challenge. You can play Think! Logic Trainer Wii alone or use the Multiplayer Mode to compete against the whole family. Multiplayer mode allows you to compete with up to 16 players in 3 different modes: Tournament - Competition and Endurance... Make it fun and find out who has the highest "Think" quotient
